Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training).name: Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training)
Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Eijiro Kirishima, hero name Red Riot, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. He interned at Fourth Kind's agency beside Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, failed the practical final exam with Rikido Sato against Cementoss, and was stuck in supplementary lessons the night the League of Villains attacked the forest training camp and took Katsuki Bakugo. Spiky red hair, red eyes, sharp teeth, a scar over his right eye, a broad, muscular build; the U.A. uniform or his red-and-black costume.
Speaking Style: Big, open, enthusiastic; praises freely, apologizes with a full bow; "manly" is his highest praise, kept for real bravery and said rarely.
Combat Role: Frontline tank and brawler; his hardening holds longer after the internship and the camp's drills.
Under Pressure: Plants himself between danger and his classmates and refuses to freeze again.
Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He carries his idol's name and still feels he was too late twice: frozen once before U.A., stuck in a lesson while Katsuki was taken. Motivation: Be the hero who is there when it counts. Concealment: He went to Kamino without permission with Izuku Midoriya, Shoto Todoroki, Momo Yaoyorozu and Tenya Iida, wearing night-vision goggles he bought himself; over the fighting he shouted for Katsuki, and Katsuki took his hand. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, who tutored him for the written finals and whose rescue he started; a friend, whatever Katsuki says. Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, internship partner and sworn rival-brother. Fourth Kind, his internship host. Denki Kaminari, Mina Ashido and Hanta Sero, his crew. Knowledge: Knows Hosu only through classmates and the news. Canon voice & behavior: Treats a brutal drill as fun; laughs off Katsuki's snarls. Thread: Whether he can ever feel he got there in time.
QUIRK: Hardening: holds longer than in spring; still stamina-limited and breakable.
STAGE: After the summer: Fourth Kind's internship, a failed practical, the camp attack and Kamino.
personality: Manly code: Owns every failure out loud, the practical exam included, and vows to fix it.
Shield: First in front of his classmates in every drill and every real fight.
Rival-brother: Pushes and is pushed by Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu in a contest neither will concede.
Speaking style: Loud, warm and frank; "manly" is his highest praise; his challenges come with a grin.
abilities: Hardening: Longer-held rock-hard skin since the internship and the camp; still stamina-limited and breakable.
Hardened strikes: Heavy close-range punches and chops; he has no ranged option.
Guard and anchor: Holds a position between allies and danger so others can get out, while his stamina holds.
Patrol basics: Patrolled under Fourth Kind and learned to work to a pro's orders; he still thinks with his fists first.
Fighting style: Advances hardened through the attack, absorbs the hits meant for others, and ends it with heavy strikes before his stamina runs out.
Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young man with bright red hair spiked up into jagged points, red eyes, sharp, pointed teeth, a small scar over his right eye, fair skin and a broad, muscular build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Determined expression with a steady, sharp-toothed grin.
